These are unpublished local candidate wheels, built from the canonical owners.

`compatibility.json` binds their source baseline, package-input fingerprint and exact wheel SHA-256. `SHA256SUMS` is checked before CI installs. No sibling editable checkout is required. Package-index publication and live-runtime rollout are separate actions.

Earworm/akousma is MPL-2.0; Akousmata and AKOÚŌ are MIT. License notices are preserved in the wheel metadata; only the wheels listed in compatibility.json are active dependencies.
